translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.71:1: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
verses.71:2: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning
verses.71:3: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me
verses.71:4: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”
verses.71:5: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night
verses.71:6: but my calls only made them run farther away
verses.71:7: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly
verses.71:8: Then I certainly called them openly
verses.71:9: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately
verses.71:10: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving
verses.71:11: He will shower you with abundant rain
verses.71:12: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers
verses.71:13: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah
verses.71:14: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺
verses.71:15: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other
verses.71:16: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp
verses.71:17: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant
verses.71:18: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺
verses.71:19: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you
verses.71:20: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”
verses.71:21: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss
verses.71:22: and who have devised a tremendous plot
verses.71:23: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’
verses.71:24: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”
verses.71:25: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah
verses.71:26: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth
verses.71:27: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers
verses.71:28: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
